collected: in the working session, in answer to direct questions
subject: Is the speech produced by the real playback path (AudioOutputQueue/StreamRenderer on the output device) audible?

answers.context: first attended run: the audio went to the system default output (a headset that was not worn). Recorded for honesty: this run was not heard.
second attended run: two spoken replies on the G435 headset, selected explicitly.

answers.quote: el sonido funciona siempre eso se da por aceptado
answers.context: standing statement: audible output works and is accepted as given.
third attended run with the Overlay open; spoken reply and a reply cut mid-sentence, on the G435 headset.

limits: Observation by one person on one machine; audibility is not machine-measurable. Machine evidence for the playback envelope is the playback-envelope sample.
